# What the file system uses once the kernel has replayed its log: the complement of the
# free space its own tools read (xfs_db freesp, dumpe2fs), but the blocks free on disk
# before that recovery wrote (what finishing intents allocates: btree blocks written
# whole; a copy needs none of their bytes). Made by
# tools/fsi_tools/fixtures/ext_xfs_replay.py; one range per line, byte offset and length.
